description: This file contains the implementation of RetryMiddlewareV2, a middleware class in the AWS SDK for PHP that handles retry logic for failed HTTP requests. It includes configurations for throttling and transient errors, and supports 'standard' and 'adaptive' modes of operation.

classes.name: Aws\RetryMiddlewareV2
classes.description: A middleware class in the AWS SDK for PHP that manages retry logic for failed requests, supporting different modes like 'standard' and 'adaptive', including strategies for throttling and transient errors.

methods.name: Aws\RetryMiddlewareV2::wrap
methods.description: A static method that returns a middleware handler function wrapping the retry logic, configured with provided settings.

methods.name: Aws\RetryMiddlewareV2::createDefaultDecider
methods.description: Creates a default decision callback to determine whether an AWS request should be retried based on the response and error types, considering quota and attempt limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the retry middleware with configuration, handler, and optional settings, setting up retry parameters and modes.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, implementing the retry logic by handling request attempts, delays, rate limiting, and retry decisions.

methods.name: exponentialDelayWithJitter
methods.description: Calculates a delay duration with jitter for exponential backoff based on the attempt count.

methods.name: isRetryable
methods.description: Determines if a given result or exception qualifies for a retry based on error codes, status, and error shape, considering configured error codes.

methods.name: isThrottlingError
methods.description: Checks whether a result is a throttling error based on error code or error shape.
